'''Chelpori''' was a small town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jilam Kester]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]] hid there from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Kester was eventually discovered and [[Squad 40]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was sent to capture him. The squad was distracted by Camas, which allowed Kester to escape.<ref name="IC 501st" />
